Vertical 9:16 photograph, shot on a 35mm lens at eye level across the road, of a red-brick Victorian terraced street in a British town at blue-hour dusk. Each small front garden has a different election sign on a stake: a green sign reading "Vote Green Party", a red one reading "Labour", a blue one reading "Vote Conservative", an orange diamond reading "Liberal Democrats". Overgrown privet hedges, low sandstone walls, warm lit windows. In the middle distance an ordinary local in a grey hoodie wheels a green wheelie bin down a front path toward the kerb, seen from behind. Slightly grainy, natural dusk light, muted colours, documentary snapshot. Thanks.
